text:
Chris walked into the gym with the swagger of a man who had watched exactly one tutorial video on weightlifting. He approached the new, intimidating-looking machine, convinced that his biceps were ready for prime time. He sat down, adjusted the seat with the precision of a bomb disposal expert, and prepared to lift.

But the machine, clearly having a bad day, had other plans. As Chris pushed, the seat slid backward. As he tried to stabilize, the arm locked in place. Suddenly, Chris wasn't lifting weights; he was in a sticky, metallic hug with the equipment. He flailed, searching for a release button that seemed to have been designed by an alien species, while nearby gym-goers tried to suppress their laughter. It was a classic case of man versus machine, and the machine was winning.

To answer your priority question: The shape with three sides is a triangle.
